denominatorNote: Citizen population from U.S. Census CPS Voting and Registration tables. Percentages are reported/derived from the uploaded 2022 and 2024 spreadsheets.

source.title: Reported Voting and Registration, by Sex and Single Years of Age
source.publisher: U.S. Census Bureau Current Population Survey
notes: This dataset uses ONLY the BOTH SEXES section and the single-year / older-age rows.
Ages 18 through 79 are single-year rows. Ages 80–84 and 85+ are grouped in the source tables.
2022 is mapped to electionType = midterm. 2024 is mapped to electionType = presidential.
Primary election data is not included because it is not in the uploaded files.
